name: Mayfair Lagoon
location: Jaydev Vihar, Bhubaneswar — 10-acre landscaped garden resort in the city centre
why_special: Bhubaneswar's iconic urban resort — 100 rooms, suites and villas across 10 acres of lakes, gardens and themed restaurants. Tripadvisor's #1 luxury hotel in the city for years running. The standout is the resort feel inside a temple city: open-air dining, a spa and a pool that few other Indian state-capital hotels match.

name: Trident Bhubaneswar
location: CB-1, Nayapalli, Bhubaneswar — 14 acres of orchards and lawns, 20 min from the airport
why_special: An Oberoi-group Trident set on 14 acres of fruit orchards and manicured lawns — just 57 rooms and 5 suites, so it stays quiet and uncrowded. The temple-city architecture and garden calm make it the pick for travellers who want a luxury base without urban noise.

name: Swosti Premium
location: P-1, Jaydev Vihar, Bhubaneswar — a five-minute walk from Mayfair Lagoon
why_special: A locally owned 5-star in the Jaydev Vihar hotel cluster — reliable rooms, a rooftop, multiple restaurants and a central location that puts the museum, Ekamra heritage walks and the airport all within easy reach. The value-conscious alternative to Mayfair and Trident.

name: Panthanivas Bhubaneswar (OTDC)
location: Lewis Road, Bhubaneswar — the OTDC state-tourism hotel near the old-town temples
why_special: The Odisha Tourism Development Corporation's Bhubaneswar property — plain, government-run and inexpensive, with a restaurant and bar. Useful as a budget base near the Lingaraj-temple old-town cluster, and a fallback when the private hotels are booked out during festival season.

name: Mayfair Cuttack
location: Mahanadi Vihar, Cuttack — a riverside Mayfair property in the silver-filigree city
why_special: Cuttack's standout luxury address — a Mayfair-group resort with landscaped grounds, a pool and multi-cuisine dining, on the Mahanadi side of the historic city. The polished choice for a Cuttack stop without backtracking to Bhubaneswar.

name: Hotel Akbari Continental
location: Haripur Road, Dolamundai, Cuttack — a long-established business hotel in the old city
why_special: One of Cuttack's longest-running full-service hotels — a reliable 3-star with restaurants and conference space, walkable to the Barabati Fort area and the silver-filigree (tarakasi) workshops the city is famous for.

name: Panthanivas Cuttack (OTDC)
location: Cuttack — the OTDC state-tourism guesthouse in the silver city
why_special: The Odisha Tourism Development Corporation's Cuttack property — a plain, low-cost government guesthouse with a restaurant. A budget fallback for travellers passing through for the Bali Jatra fair or the tarakasi filigree workshops.

name: Mayfair Heritage Puri
location: Chakratirtha Road, Puri — a beachfront luxury resort a short walk from the sea
why_special: Puri's flagship 5-star beach resort — 34 air-conditioned rooms, a spa, a pool and a multi-cuisine restaurant, set close to the beach and a manageable drive from the Jagannath Temple. The pick for travellers who want service polish and beachfront calm in a busy pilgrim town.

name: Chanakya BNR Hotel
location: Chakratirtha Road, Puri — a colonial-era railway hotel facing the sea
why_special: A genuine piece of railway heritage — the former Bengal Nagpur Railway hotel, now restored with old-world verandahs, high ceilings, a pool and sweeping sea-facing terraces. Tripadvisor reviewers consistently praise the warm service and the family-friendly heritage atmosphere.

name: Toshali Sands Nature Resort
location: Konark Marine Drive, Puri — a low-rise garden resort on the Puri-Konark road
why_special: An 'ethnic village' resort set in broad lawns and gardens on the marine drive between Puri and Konark — cottages, an outdoor pool and quiet grounds away from the town crush. A good base for couples and families who want a beach holiday with space.

name: Panthanivas Puri (OTDC)
location: Chakratirtha Road, Puri — the OTDC state-tourism hotel near the sea beach
why_special: The Odisha Tourism Development Corporation's Puri property — 52 rooms with an AC restaurant, bar and conference hall, on Chakratirtha Road close to the beach. A dependable government-rate base for pilgrims and budget travellers; books out well ahead during Rath Yatra.

name: Lotus Eco Beach Resort Konark
location: Ramachandi Beach, Konark — beachside cottages on the Puri-Konark marine drive
why_special: Konark's #1-ranked resort — beachside cottages on the shore of Ramachandi Beach, with a wellness/Panchakarma spa and quiet grounds. Just minutes from the Sun Temple and Ramachandi Temple, it is the comfortable choice for an overnight at Konark rather than day-tripping from Puri.

name: Panthanivas Konark (OTDC)
location: Konark — the OTDC state-tourism hotel near the Sun Temple
why_special: The Odisha Tourism Development Corporation's Konark property — a plain government guesthouse with a restaurant, the closest budget accommodation to the Sun Temple itself. Useful for travellers who want to be on the spot for early-morning temple light.

name: Mayfair Palm Beach Resort Gopalpur
location: Gopalpur-on-Sea, Ganjam district — a 1914 colonial heritage resort on 12 acres of seafront
why_special: A genuine heritage property — built in 1914, once part of the Oberoi group, now Mayfair's flagship Gopalpur resort across 12 acres of seafront in white-and-blue colonial architecture. The standout beach-luxury address on Odisha's southern coast.

name: Swosti Palm Resort Gopalpur
location: Gopalpur-on-Sea, Ganjam district — a 28-room resort about 200m from the beach
why_special: A former Tata guest house converted into a 28-room resort — homely, comfortable and just 200m from the sand. The mid-range alternative to Mayfair for a relaxed Gopalpur beach stay.

name: Panthanivas Chandipur (OTDC)
location: Chandipur, Balasore district — the only sea-facing accommodation at Chandipur
why_special: The Odisha Tourism Development Corporation's Chandipur property — and the only genuinely sea-facing place to stay at this unusual beach where the tide recedes up to 5km. Walk through the resort lawn straight onto the sand; the restaurant does fresh local prawn and crab.

name: Panthanivas Barkul (OTDC)
location: Barkul, on the Chilika lakeshore — beside the OTDC Water Sports Complex
why_special: The Odisha Tourism Development Corporation's flagship Chilika property — rooms right on the lake edge, with boat tours leaving from the doorstep for Kalijai Temple and Irrawaddy-dolphin spotting. The freshly cooked, very affordable restaurant and the lake-front setting make it the natural Chilika base.

name: Panthanivas Rambha (OTDC)
location: Rambha, on the southern shore of Chilika Lake
why_special: OTDC's Rambha property on the quieter southern arm of Chilika — lake views, a restaurant and boat access to the island temples and birding islets. A calmer alternative to Barkul for travellers approaching Chilika from the Berhampur/Gopalpur side.

name: Yatrinivas Satapada (OTDC)
location: Satapada, on the Chilika lakeshore at the dolphin-watching gateway
why_special: OTDC's Satapada property at the eastern dolphin-watching gateway of Chilika — spacious lake-view rooms, a restaurant and reasonably priced OTDC boat rides to the Irrawaddy-dolphin grounds and the sea mouth. The pick for travellers whose Chilika focus is dolphins.

name: Godwit Eco Cottage (Mangalajodi Ecotourism)
location: Mangalajodi village, Tangi block — northern marshes of Chilika Lake
why_special: A community-owned conservation venture run by former poachers turned protectors — bamboo-and-mud cottages with thatch roofing and a Swiss tent, on the bird-rich northern marshes of Chilika. Packages include a guided boat safari through wetlands that host over 200 bird species. A genuine responsible-tourism stay.

name: Aranyanivas Bhitarkanika (OTDC)
location: Bhitarkanika National Park — the OTDC state-tourism property in the mangrove park
why_special: The Odisha Tourism Development Corporation's Bhitarkanika property — government-run accommodation inside the mangrove national park, the dependable state-tourism base for boat safaris to spot estuarine crocodiles and the heronry. Book ahead through OTDC.

name: Sand Pebbles Bhitarkanika Jungle Resort
location: Khola, Dangmal, Rajnagar — at the Khola entry gate of Bhitarkanika National Park
why_special: A 17-key Swiss-tent and room resort at the Khola gate of Bhitarkanika — AC luxury tents, deluxe tents and family suites, with a restaurant ('The Crocodile') doing local prawn and crab. The most established private base for crocodile and bird safaris in the park.

name: Killa Aul Palace
location: Aul, on the banks of the Kharasrota River — a 40-acre palace estate near Bhitarkanika
why_special: A 16th-century royal estate turned heritage homestay, hosted by the current royal family — traditional architecture, gardens across 40 acres, kayaking on the Kharasrota and guided visits to Bhitarkanika for crocodile and bird watching. A distinctive heritage gateway to the park.

name: Lulung Aranya Nivas Resort
location: Lulung, on the Palpala River at the boundary of Simlipal Tiger Reserve
why_special: A 14-acre forest resort right on the edge of Simlipal's core zone, beside the Palpala River — about 20 riverside cottages, family rooms and meadow suites, a pool and a buffet kitchen. Tripadvisor's #1 in Baripada/Simlipal at 4/5 across 265 reviews. The most comfortable Simlipal base.

name: Similipal Nature Camps (Odisha Eco-Tourism)
location: Inside Simlipal — nature camps at Ramtirtha, Gurguria, Kumari, Jamuani and Beharipani
why_special: The Odisha Eco-Tourism department's network of nature camps inside Simlipal — bamboo huts and tented lodges at five interior locations, the only way to stay deep in the tiger reserve. Genuine wilderness with forest-department naturalists; book through ecotourodisha.com. Simlipal closes mid-June to mid-October for monsoon.

name: Tikarpada Nature Camp (Odisha Eco-Tourism)
location: Tikarpada, on the Mahanadi inside Satkosia Tiger Reserve, Angul district
why_special: The forest-department eco-camp on the bank of the Mahanadi inside the Satkosia gorge — eco cottages and Swiss cotton tents with all meals included, run with local communities. Boating in the gorge to spot gharial and mugger crocodiles, trekking and birdwatching. Book through Odisha Eco-Tourism.

name: Hotel Ambika
location: Roxy Road, near Biju Patnaik Square, Baripada — central, near the bus stand and collectorate
why_special: One of Baripada's longest-running hotels — a central 3-star with AC rooms, a restaurant and a bar, walkable to the bus stand, court and Maa Ambika temple. The most reliable in-town base for travellers heading to Simlipal or the famous Baripada Rath Yatra.

name: Regenta Inn Sambalpur
location: Farm Road, Sambalpur — a Royal Orchid (Regenta) business-class hotel in town
why_special: Sambalpur's best-rated hotel — a Royal Orchid Regenta business hotel ranked #1 in town on Tripadvisor at 4/5 across 162 reviews, known for very clean rooms and the multi-cuisine PINXX restaurant. The comfortable base for Hirakud Dam and the western-Odisha temple circuit.

name: Hotel Sheela Towers
location: Sakhipara, central Sambalpur — about 21km from Hirakud Dam
why_special: A long-running 51-room 3-star in the heart of Sambalpur — complimentary Wi-Fi, airport transfer and 24-hour room service, walkable to the Kali Mandir. A dependable mid-range base, one of the most-booked hotels in the city.

name: Hotel Hello Jeypore
location: Jeypore, Koraput district — about 23km from Koraput town
why_special: The best-regarded full-service hotel in the Koraput area — recently renovated, with clean modern rooms, AC, a restaurant and a fitness centre, in Jeypore, the district's main commercial town. The comfortable base for the Koraput tribal-belt circuit and Deomali.

name: Atithi Bhawan (Jagannath Temple Trust)
location: Link Road, Koraput town — just below the hilltop Jagannath (Sabar Srikhetra) temple
why_special: A 32-room temple-trust guesthouse run by the Koraput Jagannath Temple, in the heart of town directly below the hilltop Sabar Srikhetra shrine. Plain and very affordable — the practical pilgrim and budget base in Koraput town itself.

name: Utopia Resort Daringbadi
location: Daringbadi village, Kandhamal district — the 'Kashmir of Odisha' hill station
why_special: Daringbadi's Tripadvisor #1-ranked resort — 24 well-appointed suite and deluxe rooms with Wi-Fi and modern comforts, in the pine-and-coffee hill country of Kandhamal. The most reliable comfort base for this misty hill station.

name: The Hill Resorts Daringbadi
location: Daringbadi, Kandhamal district — a mid-range hill resort with a pool
why_special: An affordable Daringbadi hill resort with rooms, an on-site restaurant, a pool and free Wi-Fi, plus space for events and tribal-culture experiences. A good value alternative to Utopia for families exploring the Kandhamal hills.

name: Panthanivas Taptapani (OTDC)
location: Pudamari, Taptapani — beside the sulphur hot spring, Ganjam district
why_special: The Odisha Tourism property at Taptapani — 17 rooms, 40 beds, with tree-house and tent accommodation and a way-side restaurant. The standout is the plumbing: hot sulphur spring water is piped directly into the bathtubs. The forest-set hill location is genuinely lovely; maintenance is uneven.

name: Panthashala Chandaneswar (OTDC)
location: Chandaneswar, near Talasari Beach, Balasore district — the Odisha-West Bengal border coast
why_special: The Odisha Tourism Panthashala near Talasari Beach and the Chandaneswar Shiva temple — effectively the only government accommodation at this quiet border-coast beach. Plain rooms, an affordable restaurant; the practical base for an overnight at Talasari.

name: Shree Inn Talasari
location: Bindhapadmapur, by Talasari Beach, Balasore district
why_special: A beachside 3-star at Talasari — clean AC rooms, some with private sea-facing balconies, plus a rooftop pool, an in-house restaurant and a garden. The most comfortable private option at this quiet stretch of coast.

name: Deomali Desia Eco Stays
location: Taupadar village, on the Thuria-Kunduli-Deomali road — about 6km below Deomali peak, Koraput district
why_special: A community-run eco-stay in the Koraput tribal valley, about 6km below Odisha's highest peak — bamboo and mud cottages with attached western bathrooms and geysers, homely tribal-style cooking. The closest verified accommodation to the Deomali summit, and a genuine responsible-tourism stay.

name: Panthanivas Harishankar (OTDC)
location: Harishankar, on the Gandhamardan Hills, Balangir district
why_special: The Odisha Tourism Panthanivas at the Harishankar pilgrim spot — government-run accommodation on the scenic Gandhamardan hill slope beside the Harishankar temple and stream. Plain and inexpensive, it is the practical base for this remote twin-temple circuit, about 81km from Balangir town.

name: Nrusinghanath Nature Camp (Odisha Eco-Tourism)
location: Nrusinghanath, on the northern Gandhamardan Hills slope, Bargarh district
why_special: The Odisha Eco-Tourism nature camp near the Nrusinghanath temple — AC Swiss-tent suites with all meals included, tucked into the mystical Gandhamardan Hills. The only structured tier-2 stay at this remote pilgrim-and-nature spot on the Bargarh side of the hill.

name: Habalikhati Nature Camp (Odisha Eco-Tourism)
location: Habalikhati Beach, edge of Gahirmatha Marine Sanctuary, Kendrapara district
why_special: The only accommodation anywhere near the Gahirmatha turtle coast — a nine-room forest-department beach camp on the white sands of Habalikhati, reached by a roughly 2.5-hour boat ride from Gupti. Sea-facing rooms, dolphins offshore; the marine sanctuary itself has no accommodation inside. Book through Odisha Eco-Tourism.
